articleTitle: Reliability-Oriented RSA Combined with Reinforcement Learning in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a reliability-oriented RSA scheme combined with reinforcement learning in elastic optical networks. The results show that the scheme can effectively improve the network performance such as average failure probability and blocking rate.

articleTitle: Research on the Compensation Scheme for Spectral Power Tilt from Stimulated Raman Scattering in Multi-Band transmission system
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The optimization scheme for compensating the spectral power tilt is demonstrated in multi-band System, which using Raman amplifier and the Partition Particle Swarm Optimization (PPSO) algorithm. The results show that the power offset is decreased from 1.2mW to 0.29mW.

articleTitle: A rate-compatible punctured Polar code decoding scheme based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to improve transmission reliability and flexible cooperation in optical communication, rate-compatible punctured Polar codes have become a research hotspot. Aiming at the problem that the traditional decoding performance and transmission efficiency is limited, based on deep learning, a rate-compatible punctured Polar code decoding scheme is studied. We use convolutional neural network model as the basic structure of rate-compatible Polar code decoder. The log likelihood ratio values of the received sequence are input into the decoder for training. Simulation results show that the proposed decoder outperforms the traditional punctured Polar code decoder under high signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: A RSA Policy with Failure Probability Based on Reinforcement Learning in Multi-band Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an RSA policy for multi-band elastic optical networks, which is based on reinforcement learning algorithm. The experimental results show it can reduce the failure probability of the multi-band optical network.

articleTitle: Is Light-Trail Worse Than Light- Tree for Multicast Provisioning in Elastic Optical Networks?
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The problem of multicast provisioning in EONs considering splitting loss is formulated by integer linear programming for both light-trail and light-tree. Results show that the light-trail with negligible tapping-power loss can outperform the light-tree. © 2022 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Resource Optimization in Collaborative Cloud-Edge Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose energy-efficient resource optimization approaches to reduce energy consumption and blocking probability in collaborative cloud-edge elastic optical networks. Simulation results show the effectiveness of our proposed approaches.

articleTitle: A Loss-aware Continuous Hopfield Neural Network (CHNN)-based Mapping Algorithm in Optical Network-on-Chip (ONoC)
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Optical Network-on-Chip (ONoC) has become promising due to its advantages in transmission bandwidth and delay, compared to the traditional electrical interconnects on chip. However, different mapping algorithms in ONoC have different impacts on the reliability and accuracy of the results. This work proposes a Continuous Hopfield Neural Network (CHNN)-based mapping algorithm in ONoC to reduce the loss of communications, thus improving power efficiency and reliability. The evaluation results, under a given core graph and network topology, show that the proposed mapping algorithm is able to meet the loss requirement and also demonstrates low computational complexity, fast running speed and high accuracy, compared to other existing mapping algorithms.

articleTitle: Impairment-reduced Resource Allocation with Full-life-cycle SNR Guarantee in Hybrid $\mathrm{C}/\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{L}$ Band Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Focusing on the transition period of band upgrade, this paper proposes an impairment-reduced resource allocation with full-life-cycle SNR guarantee scheme. Simulation results show the proposed scheme can decrease blocking probability, premising on a higher SNR.

articleTitle: Optimized 25Gb/s Electroabsorption Modulated Tunable Lasers for O-band DWDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an O-band electroabsorption modulated tunable in-series DFB laser array (EMTL). Four lasers with 400-GHz spacing in the laser array are placed in series to avoid the usage of an optical combiner and the additional power loss. The reconstruction-equivalent-chirp technique is used to simplify the grating fabrication and precisely control the grating phase. A semiconductor optical amplifier is integrated in front of the electroabsorption modulator (EAM) to amplify the output power. As a result, we realized 16 channels with 100 GHz spacing with the SMSRs of above 40 dB. The modulation bandwidth of the EAM is above 20 GHz, and 25Gb/s data per wavelength is obtained. The proposed EMTL shows the potential application as a compact and low-cost light source for DWDM systems, such as the next-generation fronthaul networks and passive optical networks in O-band.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Aided PT-CNN in Coherent Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a transfer learning aided perturbation theory based convolutional neural network (PT -CNN) equalizer in coherent optical communication systems. We have experimentally demonstrated that transfer learning process can accelerate the update for flexible communication backbone network.

articleTitle: Hybrid Prediction Model for Passive Optical Network Traffic based on CEEMDAN and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid prediction model for passive optical network (PON) traffic, combining complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) with particle swarm optimization-support vector regression (PSO-SVR) and long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network. The model decomposes the original network traffic data by CEEMDAN, uses the approximate entropy value of the intrinsic mode function (IMF) component as the basis for selecting PSO-SVR or LSTM for individual prediction, and sums the forecast results of each component to obtain the final prediction result. Meanwhile, we selected four models based on PSO-SVR direct prediction, LSTM direct prediction, hybrid prediction based on local mean decomposition (LMD), and hybrid prediction based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) to conduct experiments on network traffic data simulated by ON/OFF sources. The experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper has better prediction results and higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis on noise impact in algorithm-based quantum computing benchmark
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Different kinds of quantum computing prototypes and simulators have been developed rapidly, and entry-level cloud-based quantum computing services begun to emerge. Various noise in quantum computer had significant impact on its execution results, which were also focus of benchmark and performance evaluation. Based on IBM Quantum Lab platform, several application algorithms have been executed in both quantum backend and simulator to verify the impact of circuit depth, different quantum noise model and parameters on the fidelity of quantum computing results. The prospect of quantum computing benchmark evaluation was also discussed.

articleTitle: Number-Theoretic Net-Based Particle Filtering for Linear Phase Noise Tracking in CO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a number-theoretic net-based particle filter (NT- PF) to dynamically estimate the linear phase noise (LPN) for CO-OFDM systems in the time domain. Inspired by the concept of uniform design (UD), we recursively draw the particles from the NT -net at each time index, which leads to a significant improvement on the algorithm efficiency compared with the conventional Gaussian particle filter (GPF). In addition, we propose a signal detection approach to estimate the LPN on the entire received signal first, then recover the transmitted signal from the received ones. The dynamic tracking performance, efficiency and robustness of the proposed NT-PF is verified in an 89 Gb/s 16-QAM CO-OFDM system.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Routing Method Based on Fuzzy Logic System in Optical Network-on-Chip (ONoC)
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: With the development of on-chip optical transmission technology, Optical Network-on-Chip (ONoC) is promising to meet the requirements of high throughput and low latency with low power consumption for the on-chip communication. To communicate from the source to the destination, routing is important which is affected by complicated factors. This work proposes an adaptive routing method based on fuzzy logic system, which comprehensively considers multiple factors to achieve multi-objective optimization and adaptively make routing decisions according to network statement information, without extra training.

articleTitle: Low-complexity Forward Error Correction For 800G Unamplified Campus Link
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The discussion about forward error correction (FEC) used for 800G unamplified link (800LR) is ongoing. Aiming at two potential options for FEC bit error ratio (BER) threshold, we propose two FEC schemes, respectively based on channel-polarized (CP) multilevel coding (MLC) and bit interleaved coded modulation (BICM), with the same inner FEC code. The field-programmable gate array (FPGA) verification results indicate that with the same FEC overhead (OH), proposed CP-MLC outperforms BICM scheme with less resource and power consumption.

articleTitle: Design of dual band microstrip antenna based on electromagnetic band gap structure
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Because the antenna is an important passive component in the RF front-end of mobile communication, some studies have found that the combination of EBG and antenna can effectively improve the performance of the antenna. In this paper, a dual band microstrip antenna based on EBG structure is designed, which improves the gain of the antenna, and the resonant frequencies are 2.4 GHz and 3.5 GHz. After simulation, the return loss at two resonant frequencies is less than −19.5 dB, which basically meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: A bidirectional WRC-FPLDs chaotic communication system with wavelength switchable chaotic carrier
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate theoretically a bidirectional weak resonant-cavity Fabry-Perot laser diodes (WRC-FPLDs) chaotic communication system with wavelength switchable chaotic carrier. In such a scheme, one of the WRC-FPLD under fiber Bragg grating (FBG) feedback is utilized as a driving WRC-FPLD (D-WRC-FPLD), and the other two WRC-FPLDs are used as response WRC-FPLDs (R-WRC-FPLDs). Through adjusting the Bragg wavelength of FBG and the feedback intensity, a specify longitude mode in D-WRC-FPLD can be stimulated and output a chaotic light. Thus, the D-WRC-FPLD subject to FBG feedback can provide a chaos driving light with a switchable central wavelength. The simulated results show that, the time delay signature (TDS) of the chaos light with switchable wavelength from D-WRC-FPLD under suitable feedback parameters is greatly weakened. And high-quality chaos synchronization between the two R-WRC-FPLDs is obtained via an identical injection chaotic signal with suppressed TDS from D-WRC-FPLD. Due to the switchability of chaotic carrier wavelength, such a bidirectional chaotic communication system has potential application prospects in wavelength-division multiplexing chaotic optical communication.

articleTitle: Complex Long Short-Term Memory Neural Networks for Fiber Nonlinearity Equalization in Long-Haul Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a complex Long short-term memory nonlinear equalizer. Compared with linear compensation, Q-factors of single-channel and 7-channel are improved by 0.8dB and 0.6dB. The real multiplications are reduced by 28% compared to real-valued LSTM.

articleTitle: Modulation characteristics of PZT phase modulator under temperature variation
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The regulation of modulation voltage and modulation phase under the influence of different ambient temperature is investigated. It provides theoretical and practical data support for solving the impedance matching problem in PZT-FOCT.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow linewidth Brillouin laser
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We combine the principle of stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) effect and optical injection locking to realize an ultra-narrow linewidth fiber laser. The absolute linewidth of this fiber laser is less than 10 Hz. At the same time, the device can provide microwaves with narrow linewidth and low phase noise.

articleTitle: Thermally Stable Refractometer Using Capillary-Based Structural Long-Period Gratings
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a thermally stable refractometer based on capillary with arc-discharge-induced structural long-period gratings (SLPGs) between two single-mode fibers. Transmission spectral performances of the SLPGs were investigated theoretically and experimentally. The refractive index (RI) sensing characteristics of SLPGs with period of 1 mm and period number of 4 were further studied, showing a maximum RI sensitivity of 8409.2 nm/RIU in the RI region of 1.435-1.443. In addition, the proposed SLPGs presents thermally stable to temperature variations. Therefore, the proposed capillary-based refractometer can be potential in the application of environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Security-aware Service Mapping in Physical-layer Secured Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a security-aware algorithm for mapping services with heterogeneous security demands over lightpaths in optical transport networks with physical-layer encryption. Simulation results show the algorithm can manage the security-constraint properly.

articleTitle: Double-Pass L-band Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier with Tunable Gain Clamping
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A double-pass L-band erbium-doped fiber amplifier with tunable gain clamping is demonstrated by using a linear laser cavity configuration formed by a pair of fiber Bragg gratings at the wavelength of 1565 nm. A C/L-band wavelength division multiplexer is used to split the signal in the L-band which is then reflected by an optical circulator-based loop mirror to form a double-pass configuration. A variable optical attenuator (VOA) is inserted into linear laser cavity to tune gain clamping. Experimental results show that the clamped-gains are 13.05, 20.83 and 26.29 dB for VOA settings of 0, 9 and 15 dB, respectively. The corresponding dynamic gain-clamped range of the input signal power is up to -5, -10 and -15 dBm respectively, and variations of clamped-gain are less than 0.34 dB.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy for detection of nanoplastic particles
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the detection of PS nanoplastics with a size of 100 nm by using surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) with gold nanoparticles. It provides an efficient method for the detection of nanoplastics.

articleTitle: Implementation method of reconfigurable all-optical XOR logic gate based on dual-parallel phase modulators
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We have proposed a new and simple scheme to implement XOR logic operation in optical domain just enabled by dual-parallel phase modulator. Numerical analysis and simulation have been successfully carried out at the speed of lOGb/s.

articleTitle: Physical-Layer Hardware Authentication of Constellation Impairments Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A physical-layer hardware authentication is proposed using I/Q constellation impairments, where the identification accuracy of 98% (SNR@15dB) is achieved with residual networks.

articleTitle: Improving thermal stability of a closed-loop resonant fiber-optic gyroscope using a double demodulation technique
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper presents the thermal stability improvement of a closed-loop resonant fiber-optic gyroscope using a reciprocal modulation and double demodulation technique, showing stable behavior with a bias stability of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.3^{\mathrm{o}}/\mathrm{h}$</tex> in a temperature change.

Author Keywords: reciprocal modulation and double demodulation technique

articleTitle: A Multi-Step Prediction Algorithm based on Correlated Traffic and Multi-Head Attention for PON
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a traffic prediction algorithm applied to dynamic bandwidth allocation in high speed PON. The algorithm takes into account traffic correlation and realize multi-step prediction based on multi-head attention and neural networks. Simulation results show that proposed algorithm can improve prediction accuracy by 8.25% compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Leveraging Heterogeneous NFV Platforms for QoS-aware Reconfiguration of vNF Service Trees
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We study the problem of how to realize quality-of-service (QoS) aware reconfiguration of virtual network function service trees (vNF-STs) over the heterogeneous network function virtualization (NFV) platforms that include virtual machines (VMs), docker containers, and programmable data plane switches (PDP-SWs), and propose an effective heuristic algorithm.

articleTitle: Double-pass L-band erbium-doped fiber amplifier with high gain and low noise figure
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A two-stage cascaded double-pass structure long- wavelength band (L-band) erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA) is demonstrated. Two 980 nm laser diodes (LDs) are used as forward pumping sources for the two amplification stages. The gain of the L-band EDF A is 35.2-42.5 dB in the wavelength range of 1570–1610 nm, and the noise figure (NF) is 4.11-6.47 dB. In addition, the saturated output power of the L- band EDFA is 14 dBm.

articleTitle: An Optoelectronic Joint Equalization Scheme Based on Photonic Reservoir Computing and TDNN for CD and Nonlinearity Compensation in IM/DD Link
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and numerically study a joint equalization scheme combining neuromorphic photonic reservoir computing with time-delay neural-network for chromatic dispersion compensation and nonlinear compensation in IM/DD system, achieving bitrate-distance product up to 11,200Gps·km in C-band.

articleTitle: Link Recovery with Spectrum Overlap (LR-wSO) in Elastic Optical Networks (EONs)
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a link recovery algorithm with spectrum overlap in elastic optical networks is proposed. Simulation results indicate that the designed algorithm has better performance in terms of recovery success ratio and resource utilization.

articleTitle: Transceiver IQ Skew Compensation and Estimation By Widely Linear Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a transceiver IQ skew monitoring method by using filter coefficients of widely linear equalizer, which can monitor both transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) IQ skew simultaneously with the monitor error within sub-ps.

articleTitle: Real-time vibration locating phase-sensitive OTDR based on envelope extraction and undersampling technique
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Real-time vibration localization and phase demodulation at a low system cost are still the challenges for phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\Phi\text{-}\text{OTDR)}$</tex>. In this paper, undersampling technique is utilized to decrease the data volume, also contributing to the reduction of the system cost. Digital envelope extraction is applied to quickly locate the vibration, and phase demodulation with the undersampled data is also performed for waveform analysis. This flexible scheme improves the real-time performance of the system, also offering an enhancement to the applicability of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Phi\text{-}\text{OTDR}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Low complexity blind Phase noise estimation for CO-OFDM transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A phase noise estimation method based on a blind phase search is proposed. The effectiveness of this method is verified in the 40Gbaud CO-OFDM transmission system. Compared with the original algorithm, this method can reduce the computational complexity (CC) by reducing the use of a 25% comparator without performance degradation.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of mini MIMO antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This article designs three MIMO antennas for WLAN and WIMAX. The center resonance frequencies are 2.4 GHz, 3.5 GHz, and 5.2 GHz, respectively. The electromagnetic simulation software HFSS is used to design and optimize the MIMO antenna. The MIMO antenna is designed with dielectric substrates with different thicknesses and sizes and antenna element patches with different shapes. Use the antenna layout in each frequency band to obtain good isolation. Make the center working frequency reach more than 15dB. The antenna has the characteristics of omnidirectional radiation in the working frequency band, and the isolation and gain are calculated through the S parameter sweep frequency setting, and then the optimization function is used to optimize and modify the antenna.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity-Tolerant GS-4D 7 bit/4D-Sym Modulation Format based on Adjacent Quadrant Constellations Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a novel 7 bit/4D-sym geometrically-shaped four-dimensional (GS-4D) modulation format based on adjacent quadrant constellations multiplexing, which achieved high nonlinearity tolerance while ensuring lower demodulation complexity. Results show that GS-4D outperforms PM-8QAM and 64PRS.

articleTitle: Global Power and OSNR Analyses for Super C band Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Broadband optical transmission with 6-THz super C band is achieved with cost-effective classical-physics-model-based global power and OSNR analyses (GPOA). The end to end GPOA estimation error over 8-span SMF link is less than 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: High Sensitivity Optical Fiber FP Interferometer based on Vernier Effect for Temperature Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A temperature sensor based on fiber Fabry Perot interferometer (FPI) is proposed and demonstrated, which is composed of hollow core fiber (HCF) and cascaded multimode fiber (MMF). The optical Vernier effect is successfully realized through FP cavities with different lengths of HCF and MMF, and the temperature sensitivity is significantly improved. The temperature sensitivity of 69.2 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{pm}/^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> is achieved by detecting the generated spectrum envelope through the FPI's spectrum. A high sensitivity optical fiber temperature sensing system with low complexity, good linearity, short response time, and low cost can be realized with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a network management system for bidirectional VLC networking
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this study, a network management system for bidirectional visible light communication (VLC) networking is proposed, which is essential for the management of LiFi networks in practical applications. The network management system can monitor and control the operational state of the VLC networking, ensuring that it can operate normally, reliably and efficiently. By analyzing the characteristics of VLC networking and its specific management requirements, we complete the design of the network management system, including the overall architecture, functions of each module and related interaction protocols. We implement the designed network management system based on software programming, and complete the functional verification of the system using the established bidirectional VLC networking. The experimental results demonstrate that the network management system works well and can effectively manage the functions and performance of VLC networking. In addition, the system can also realize the calculation and analysis of key performance indicators, so that the relevant parameters can be adjusted to optimize the operation state of the VLC networking.

articleTitle: Measurement and Analysis of Brillouin Scattering Spectra with Multiple Peaks in Single Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the properties of the Brillouin scattering spectra with multi-peak in the ultra-low-loss G.654 fiber and the G.655 fiber, and show the influence of optical fiber length on the stimulated Brillouin threshold.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman Filter Scheme for Polarization Demultiplexing in PDM-PCS-64QAM Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Extended Kalman filter (EKF) algorithm is optimized for PCS-64QAM signals polarization de multiplexing. It can achieve excellent de multiplexing performance with 8ps DGD and 1Mrad/s RSOP while MMA and original EKF both fail to work.

articleTitle: Wideband phase noise measurement of microwave signals based on all-optical microwave signal processing
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A scheme for wideband microwave phase noise measurement is proposed based on all-optical microwave signal processing. In the experiment, accurate, high -sensitivity phase noise measurement is demonstrated ranging from 10 to 35 GHz.

articleTitle: Improved accuracy of PMD measurement based on spectral periodic interference
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a calculation method which can improve the measurement accuracy of polarization mode dispersion (PMD) in optical fiber composite overhead ground wire (OPGW) by fixed analyzer method. The proposed method calculates the interference period from the optical spectrum and extends the number of extreme points to the decimal fraction, which increases the accuracy of estimation of mean differential group delay (DGD) by extrema density (ED) and will not impact on measurement time or instrument cost. The results of experiment show that the PMD values calculated by the proposed method are closer to those measured by the EXFO instrument than by the traditional method.

articleTitle: Three-stage Gain-clamped L-band EDFA with Low Noise-figure Base on Ring Lasing
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrated a three-stage gain-clamped L-band erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA) with a low noise figure. The first stage was used as the preamplifier to improve the noise figure performance of the EDFA. The gain clamping was achieved by forming a ring laser base on the second and third stages by combining two C/L-band wavelength-division multiplexers (WDMs). As a result, the gain was clamped at 21.75 dB with a gain variation of less than 0.22 dB from an input signal power of −34 dBm to −10 dBm at 1580 nm. The noise figure was between 4.4 dB to 5.5 dB in the wavelength ranging from 1570 to 1610nm.

articleTitle: K-Optimal Grouping Distributed Steiner Sub-Tree Scheme for All-Optical Multicast in Elastic Optical Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a K-optimal grouping distributed steiner sub-tree (K-OG-DSST) algorithm in elastic optical datacenter networks (EODN) for all-optical multicast services. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can significantly reduce the blocking probability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Analog Flat Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Digital communication baseband equipment needs to test the bit error rate and threshold in the passband through the if noise generator. The flatness and cut-off frequency of the signal passband of the if noise generator will affect the measurement accuracy. The design idea is to adopt the method of analog filtering and digital filtering. This paper discusses the design and implementation of analog flat bandpass filter. Through the research of LC filter, the design value of LC element is obtained, the simulation calculation and verification test of analog filter are carried out, and the suitable scheme meeting the design index is obtained.

articleTitle: Secure OCDM Multi-Core Multiplexed Short-Reach Optical Communication Based on High dimensional Constellation Perturbation
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a secure orthogonal chirped division multiplexing (OCDM) short-reach optical communication based on high-dimensional constellation perturbation, which improves the security of the transmission system and reduces its bit error rate.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforced Virtual Network Embedding in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a multi-agent deep reinforced virtual network embedding algorithm (MADRVNE). Simulation results demonstrate that the MADRVNE algorithm outperforms the other three algorithms in terms of average resource utilization and acceptance rate.

articleTitle: Cross-Domain Trust Architecture: A Federated Blockchain Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Abstraet- This paper proposes a federated hierarchical trust interaction (FHTI) architecture for the cross-domain loT. FHTI combines federated learning with blockchain to propose a credible evaluation model which ensures the safety and dependability of blockchain users.

articleTitle: A high-linearity and fast-response direct-modulated DFB laser for low-cost FMCW Lidar
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a two-section DFB laser for the FMCW lidar system. The measured frequency nonlinearity of down-ramp and up-ramp at 200 kHz modulation rate was 0.185 % and 2.88 %, the response time was below 100 ns.

articleTitle: High-speed Digital-to-analog Conversion by Fiber-dispersion-based Temporal Compression
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A photonics-based digital-to-analog conversion scheme is proposed by applying optical temporal compression to the signal generated by a low-speed electrical digital-to-analog converter (DAC). The proposed photonics-based DAC uses photonic techniques to increase the DAC sampling rate while reserving the high accuracy property of an electrical DAC. In the experiment, a photonics-based DAC with an equivalent sampling rate of 40 Gsa/s is established in which the temporal compression factor is 2. With this photonics-based DAC, a pulsed microwave signal centered at 6 GHz is generated with the effective number of bits (ENOB) being 5.58. In addition, the generation of linearly frequency modulated signal is also demonstrated, which further verifies the feasibility of the proposed photonics-based DAC.

articleTitle: Digital Coherent Fronthual Employing Sample Bits Interleaving and Uneven 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a digital coherent fronthaul system exploiting sample bits interleaving and uneven 16-QAM. The results indicate that 6dB EVM sensitivity enhancement can be achieved compared with standard 16-QAM.

articleTitle: All-Optical Three-Mode Switch Based on Graphene-Embedded Vertical Directional Couplers
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed an all-optical mode switch based on graphene-embedded vertical directional couplers, which can switch the TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>, TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> and TMoo modes with extinction ratios higher than 16.7 dB and control-light powers lower than 1.84 mW.

articleTitle: Closed-loop Resonant Fiber-Optic Gyroscope based on a broadband source
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper presents a closed-loop resonant fiber-optic gyroscope with a broadband source. In the experiment, a bias stability of 0.008°/h is successfully demonstrated with a 100m-long fiber-optic ring resonator of 7.6 cm diameter.

articleTitle: Photonics-aided 0.3-THz Wireless Transmission Using DSCM-OFDM Modulation and Heterodyne Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We have proposed a photonics-aided 0.3 THz wireless transmission system based on DSCM-OFDM which has low requirements for ADC bandwidth. The simulation results show that the performance of DSCM-OFDM system is similar to that of OFDM system.

articleTitle: Sensitive enhanced refractive index sensor based on series tapered thin-core microfiber with Vernier effect
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We reported a refractive index (RI) optical fiber sensor using series tapered thin-core microfiber (TTCMF) based on the optical Vernier effect. In the RI measurement range from 1.3313 to 1.3392, an ultra-high RI sensitivity of - 15,053.411 nm/RIU was obtained by using the series structure, which was about 4.65 times higher than that of the single TTCMF one. Based on the advantages of high RI sensitivity and simple structure, the proposed sensors have great potential in the biosensing fields.

articleTitle: High-throughput Trapping of Nanoparticles Based on a Copper-Coin-Shaped Nanotweezer
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose an all-dielectric copper-coin-shaped nanotweezer for the high-throughput trapping of the 60 nm nanoparticles. The nanotweezer can provide multiple optical hotspots for multiplexed trapping of nanoparticles, which shows excellent potential in biomedicine.

articleTitle: High senstivity temperature sensor based on an acrylate coated no core fiber structure
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A high sensitivity temperature sensor based on an acrylate coated singlemode fiber-no core fiber-singlemode fiber structure (AC-SNCS) is reported. Sensor samples with different coating lengths are investigated. It is found that sensor's temperature sensitivity increases with coating length at first, and then it becomes relatively stable after a certain length of coating. The highest temperature sensitivity of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5.81\text{nm}/^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> was experimentally achieved when the coating length was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 6\mathbf{mm}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Broadband OAM modes excitation within a single-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A helical long-period fiber grating (HLPFG) based on a single-mode fiber (SMF) is prepared near the dispersion turning point (DTP) to excite orbital angular momentum (OAM) mode in a broadband wavelength range. By calculating the phase match condition and optimizing the grating period, the mode conversion with a bandwidth of 182.0 nm and a conversion efficiency of 90% is achieved in the proposed HLPFG.

articleTitle: Fast and multi-band RCS measurement based on a microwave photonic inverse synthetic aperture radar
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: With the rapid development of radar signature reduction techniques and increment of radar frequency band, fast and multi-band radar cross-section (RCS) measurement is highly required in fields such as radar detection and target recognition. This paper proposes a scheme for fast RCS measurement with multiple bands based on the microwave photonic inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR). With the advantages of frequency reconfigurable and large bandwidth provided by microwave photonics, RCS can be obtained from the multi-band and ultra-high resolution ISAR image based on Parseval's theorem with fast speed and high precision. In a proof-of-concept experiment, the target's RCS characteristics in the X, Ku, and Ka bands are analyzed, showing that the ISAR-based RCS measurement precision is about 0.5 dBsm in the near-field measurement with a measurement speed of about 70 ms each time.

articleTitle: Wavelength Tuned Laser Based on Few-mode Long-period Fiber Grating
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We construct a comb filter based on the dislocation splicing between optical fibers. Using the mode switching properties of few-mode long-period fiber gratings (FM-LPFG) and the interference effect of dislocation splicing, single-wavelength, dual-wavelength, three-wavelength and four-wavelength tunable laser generation are produced in the laser. In addition, by adjusting the polarization state and power in the cavity, a high-quality ultrafast laser pulse output with a wavelength of 1567.72 nm and a signal-to-noise ratio maintained above 61 dB is achieved. The switchable multi-wavelength all-fiber lasers have potentially important applications for laser processing, wavelength-division multiplexing and signal processing.

articleTitle: Optically Anisotropic Polymer Materials based on MOF Nano-confined Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We review our contributions in obtaining optically anisotropic polymer materials, where the polymer chains are encapsulated and orientated in highly regular and ordered nano-confined channels of metal-organic frameworks, thus their anisotropic properties are greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: Experimental Assessments of a AWGR Based Optical Switching Network for Distributed Reinforcement Learning Training
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An arrayed waveguide grating router based all-optical switching network is proposed to accelerate the communication phase of distributed reinforcement learning training. Experimental investigations validate 465ns worker-to-server latency with error-free communication at 0.9 traffic load.

articleTitle: A Novel Optical Microcavity Based on Nonperiodic High Index Contrast Subwavelength Gratings
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We report a novel optical microcavity based on nonperiodic high index contrast subwavelength gratings. The proposed microcavity has high quality factor and small effective mode volume, which can be widely used in optoelectronic devices.

Author Keywords: nonperiodic high index contrast subwavelength grating

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of the Gain Spectrum of EDFA
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The gain spectra of an erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA) have been analyzed by numerical simulation. The effects of erbium-doped fiber length, signal power, pump power and pump direction on the gain spectrum of EDFA are investigated.

articleTitle: Research on the groove structure of InP-based photodetector electrode
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a novel low-loss photodetector electrode is reported on the basis of optimizing the traditional electrode model. The groove electrode can increase the bandwidth of the photodetector by 8.51GHz than the conventional electrode.

articleTitle: Probabilistically Shaped High-order QAM Coherent Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Probabilistically shaped (PS) high-order QAM coherent optical communication is attractive for large-capacity fiber transmission due to its high spectrum efficiency and sensitivity. In this work, we present its principle and key features in detail.

articleTitle: Universal Photonic Logic-Matrix Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a universal photonic logic-matrix unit using highly nonlinear fiber and microring matrix array, which realizes programmable two-input logic. And the function of comparator and half-adder has been executed at 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: The Enabling Key Technologies for Next Optical Access Network
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper summarizes the flexible metro-access convergence passive optical network (PON) architecture-elastic software defined optical access network (ESDAN) and reviews the possible technologies from the physical layer (PHY) and the media access control (MAC) layer.

articleTitle: LSTM-DFE equalizer for 25 Gbit/s/λ IM/DD Super-PON
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A long short-term memory-DFE equalizer for 25 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{Gbit}/\mathbf{s}/\lambda$</tex> IM/DD Super-PON is proposed. Simulation results show that a 7 dB sensitivity improvement is obtained, compared with long short-term memory and Volterra nonlinear equalizer.

articleTitle: Black Phosphorus: Mid-Infrared Light-Emitting Properties and Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Black phosphorus has attracted great attentions from two-dimensional material community due to its high carrier mobility, widely tunable bandgap and decent light-matter interactions. In particular, its narrow bandgap and high intrinsic light-emitting quantum efficiency make it a promising material platform for high-performance mid-infrared light-emitting devices. Here, I will review the recent advances in the research field of mid-infrared light-emitting properties, devices and applications of black phosphorus.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency optimization of heterogeneous network resources based on OFDMA
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An improved bat algorithm is proposed to increase the energy efficiency of macro/femtocell heterogeneous networks based on OFDMA. Simulation results indicate that the algorithm enhances the optimization ability and convergence speed in later stages.

articleTitle: Hybrid dual-wavelength solitons fiber laser manipulated by a 3D rotatable PBS
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Through finely 3D rotating the PBS to manipulate the polarization of light signal in the cavity, versatile hybrid dual-wavelength mode-locking operations are experimentally demonstrated, and the corresponding output characteristics are investigated in detail.

articleTitle: Sync-Sequence based Synchronization Scheme in QKD-Secured Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more attention has been paid to the information security of access network, so the application of quantum key distribution (QKD) technology in access network has gradually become a feasible scheme. However, with the application of QKD technology in access network, the support of synchronization technology becomes more important. This paper provides a synchronization scheme in QKD-Secured access network scenario and realizes the synchronization function. Based on this, a sync-sequence based synchronization scheme is proposed to reduce the synchronization error of the system, and then reduce the probability of encrypted service transmission failure caused by non-synchronization.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Salinity/Refractive Index Sensor based on Fiber Ring Laser with Tapered Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a fiber ring laser with single mode fiber - tapered no core fiber - single mode fiber structure (STNS structure) was proposed and demonstrate to be an ultrahigh sensitive refractive index and salinity sensor. The laser located at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 1555$</tex> nm, with a narrow 3-dB bandwidth of 0.06 nm and high signal-to-noise ratio of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 45\mathbf{dB}$</tex>. The NaCI salinity sensitivity and RI sensitivity of our designing were 0.627 nm/(g/L) and 3761.2 nm/RIU, respectively, with a good linearity of 0.998. It has potential to be widely applied in chemical and biological analysis, ocean monitoring and protection of ecosystems.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of LDPC Coding under Multiple Scattering in Ultraviolet Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes are applied to multiple scattering communication channels based on Monte Carlo (MC) method. A simulated Ultraviolet (UV) communication system based on binary phase shift keying (BPSK) modulation is built. The effects of different decoding algorithms, number of iterations, and different receiver field-of-view (FOV) angles on the performance of the UV communication system are analyzed, respectively.

articleTitle: 800Gbps Visible Light Communication System Employing WDM and OAM Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrate a visible light communication (VLC) system based on compact eight-color laser transmitter. A capacity of 805Gbit/s and mean spectral efficiency of 50.3 bits/s/Hz can be achieved utilizing 8-λ, WDM and to-DAM modes multiplexing.

articleTitle: Mechanism analysis and suppression method of mode hopping in high-precision interferometer fiber optic gyroscopes under large angular acceleration
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: High-precision interferometer fiber optic gyroscopes (I-FOG) always employ fiber coil with long length and large diameter, which then results in a small optical measurement range. In order to enlarge its measurement range, cross-stripe technology and over-range saturated output technology are usually adopted. When the input angular acceleration exceeds the response capacity of I-FOG, the mode hopping phenomenon, which is caused by the insufficient ability of angular acceleration resistance of I-FOG and exhibits as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\phi_{\boldsymbol{s}1}\pm 2\boldsymbol{k}\pi (>\phi_{\boldsymbol{s}1}$</tex> is the actual response value, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k=1,2,3\ldots$</tex>), usually occurs. In this paper, the mechanism of mode hopping fault is theoretically analyzed. Subsequently, a number of methods such as the structural optimization to reduce translation-rotating coupling, increasing the response bandwidth and using external reset signal, are proposed. Experiments show that the angular acceleration resistance ability of I-FOG is improved to 220000 deg/s2 from 80000 deg/s2, which greatly improves the reliability of high-precision I-FOG under large angular acceleration.

articleTitle: Integration Extraction Method Aided Linear Optical Sampling System
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an integration extraction method aided linear optical sampling systems. Moreover, based on the optimum integration time, we have experimentally demonstrated that the value of EVM can be changed from 15.80% to 14.78%.

articleTitle: Femtosecond-laser microprinting of fiber-tip clamped-beam probe for high-sensitivity micro-force measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Micromanipulation and biological, material science, and medical applications often require direct or indirect control and measurement of forces asserted on small objects. Here, we demonstrate − for the first time the microprinting of a novel fiber-tip-polymer clamped-beam probe micro-force sensor for the examination of biological samples. The proposed sensor consists of two bases, a clamped beam, and a force-sensing probe, which were developed using a femtosecond-laser-induced two-photon polymerization technique. A miniature all-fiber micro-force sensor of this type exhibited an ultrahigh force sensitivity of 1.51 nm/μN, a detection limit of 54.9 nN, and an unambiguous sensor measurement range of approximately 2.9 mN. The Young's modulus of polydimethylsiloxane, a butterfly feeler, and human hair were successfully measured with the proposed sensor. To the best of our knowledge, this fiber sensor has the smallest force-detection limit reported to date, comparable to that of an atomic force microscopes (AFM). As such, we believe that this device will be beneficial for high-precision biomedical and material science examination.

articleTitle: Key Provisioning in QKD-enhanced Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In the scenario of QKD enhanced IoT, a novel gateway model and a quantum key resource diversion method are proposed. Simulation shows that it has good performance in key supply on the edge of IoT.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of distributed acoustic sensing systems based on Rayleigh-backscattering and wFBG-reflecting
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A low-noise, low-calculation, long-range distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system based on phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (Φ-OTDR) is proposed and analyzed. Based on this system, measurements were performed by using both Rayleigh backscattering light and wFBG-reflected light. An average phase noise of -47 dB can be achieved with wFBGs, which is about 15 dB lower than that with Rayleigh backscattering. The experimental results illustrate the potential for wFBGs in the proposed DAS system, which can demodulate external disturbance signal with good linearity and wide frequency response range, and immune to interference fading and polarization fading.

articleTitle: Low-Loss and Low-Crosstalk Fan-in/Fan-out Device for Multicore Fiber Using a Femtosecond Laser Direct Inscription Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrate a low-loss and low-crosstalk fan-in/fan-out device for three-core fiber using femtosecond laser direct inscription. The fabricated FI/FO device has an averaged insertion loss of 1.33 dB and a crosstalk smaller than −49 dB.

articleTitle: An efficient and simple method to deal with PMD effects and ICI
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this study, an efficient and simple method to eliminate polarization mode dispersion (PMD) effects and inter-carrier interference (ICI) is proposed. The method is validated on a high-density dual-polarization wavelength division multiplex (WDM) system by simulation. Furthermore, we evaluate the Q factors for the WDM signals before and after our compensation algorithm, and the results indicate that the proposed algorithm can improve the Q factor by 2.4dB on average in long-distance optical fiber transmission.

articleTitle: A Novel Scheme to Reduce the ONU's DSP Complexity for IMDD-OFDMA-PON
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The orthogonal frequency division multiplexing passive optical network (OFDM-PON) is one of the significant topics for the next generation PON technology, and how to minimize the size of DSP processing and the number of sampling rate is paramount important to realize cost saving. This paper investigates a novel scheme for reducing the ONU's DSP complexity for intensity-modulated and direct-detection (IM-DD)-OFDMA-PON. Results efficiently verify the proposed scheme as well as ensure the transmission performance.

articleTitle: 1.7Gbps visible light transmission over 100m POF employing a 638nm laser and MLP post-equalizer
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a post-equalization scheme based on Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for DFT-Spread OFDM modulation in a communication system with Laser Diodes (LDs) and Plastic Optical Fiber (POF). This approach successfully achieved a data rate of 1.7 Gbit/s 16QAM-DFT-Spread OFDM modulation transmitted over 100 m POF with a bit error rate (BER) below the 7% FEC threshold <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.8\times 10^{-3}$</tex>. The proposed method improves the Q factor by 1.13 dB compared with the Volterra equalizer's post-equalization results. The experimental results verify that the MLP-based post-equalization scheme has a better nonlinear compensation effect in the application scenario where plastic optical fiber is used as the transmission medium. Finally, we successfully demonstrated a 100-meter POF transmission system using 16QAM-DFT-Spread OFDM modulation format at 1.7Gbps with BER below <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.8\times 10^{-3}$</tex> by utilizing MLP.

articleTitle: Research and design of dual band microstrip filter
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: With the reduction of spectrum resources available in modern communication, higher requirements are put forward for the out of band suppression, frequency selection characteristics and signal-to-noise ratio of the filter. Based on the traditional stepped impedance resonator, a microstrip multifrequency filter based on open branch loaded stepped impedance resonator is designed and implemented in this paper.

articleTitle: A Compressive Sensing Imaging System Using Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A compressive sensing (CS) imaging system employing a multimode fiber is proposed. Broadband light from mode-locked laser goes through a multimode fiber and then produces speckles, which are randomly distributed and ideal for CS imaging. The proposal has the merits of low-cost and easy access compared with the traditional CS method using pseudorandom binary sequence (PRBS). What's more, the utilization of CS method and photonic time stretch (PTS) technique could achieve ultrafast CS imaging. In this work, the randomly distributed speckles are experimentally investigated and utilized to demonstrate the proposed CS imaging. The demonstrated result illustrates a 27 × 27 pixels image is recovered with varied compression ratios.

articleTitle: Computing Task Migrating Scheme Considering Inter-Core Crosstalk for MEC Servers in SDM-MONs
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Aiming to decrease the blocking probability of computation-intensive tasks generated by client, this paper proposes a computing task migrating scheme in terms of inter-core crosstalk (CTMS-ICC). Experimental results show that the proposed scheme has lower blocking probability compared with the benchmark scheme.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-temperature Sensors Based on Sapphire Fiber Bragg Gratings Created with Femtosecond Laser Direct Writing Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We reported on a new method for fabricating sapphire fiber Bragg gratings (SFBGs) using a femtosecond laser direct writing technique, i.e., line-by-line (LbL) scanning technique and Point-by-Point (PbP) method. At first, we fabricated a SFBG by using LbL scanning technique, and this SFBG exhibits a reflectivity of 6.3%. Moreover, we fabricated multi-layer SFBGs using this method, and the reflectivity was enhanced to 34.1 %. Furthermore, we proposed a filamentation process to enlarge the area of refractive index modulations (RIMs). An SFBG with a reflectivity of 2.3 % could be created by using PbP method, and the fabrication time only requires ~ 1.1 s. An SFBG array including five SFBGs was constructed successfully. In addition, we used an inert gas-sealed packaging method to suppress the lossy spots formed on surface of sapphire fiber after a high-temperature test. The long-term thermal stability of the SFBG was greatly enhanced. As a result, such an SFBG can be applied in many fields, including metallurgical, power, and aviation industries.

articleTitle: Dispersion-managed dual-wavelength fiber laser based on nonlinear polarization evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We report the generation of dual-wavelength dispersion-managed solitons in a near-zero anomalous-dispersion Er-doped mode-locked fiber laser. Transmissive dual channels are provided by birefringence filtering effect. The dual-wavelength mode-locking centers at 1539.1 and 1578.8 nm with the repetition-rate difference of 430 Hz. Furthermore, coexistence of the soliton and the bound state is also observed.

articleTitle: Edge-cloud Collaborative Computing-Networking Integrated Services Provisioning in Multilayer Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a matching-based approach integrating the service information and network status, to provide computing and network resources joint allocation for edge-cloud collaboration services in multilayer elastic optical networks.

articleTitle: A method of simultaneously detecting the damage position and degree of wind turbine blades based on OFDR
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a method for simultaneous detection of the position and degree of wind turbine blade damage based on Optical Frequency Domain Reflection (OFDR) mechanism. The spatial resolution of damage localization by this method is 0.01m, and the damage degree identification error is less than 3.4%. It provides a new method for online damage monitoring of wind turbine blades.

articleTitle: A Fiber Design Automation Platform Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An optical fiber design automation platform based on deep learning is built. It supports the fast, accurate and flexible design of weak-coupling few mode fiber, with arbitrary dispersion single mode fiber and so on.

articleTitle: Simple Optical Frequency Comb Generation Based on the Optoelectronic Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The simple optical frequency comb (OFC) with tunable free spectra range (FSR) based on the optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Thanks to the gain switching effect when the big microwave signal, which is generated by the OEO, is directly modulated to the laser, no optical modulator or microwave source are employed in the system. The FSR can be tuned from 4.33GHz to 7.1GHz by simply changing the bias current of the laser. There are at least 9 combs within the 10-dB power fluctuation. When FSR is 5.4GHz, the phase noise of basic microwave signal reaches to −122dBc/Hz@10kHz.

articleTitle: Research on high resolution distributed optical fiber dynamic strain detection system
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed optical fiber dynamic strain detection system based on double pulse heterodyne demodulation is proposed, and its experimental calibration is carried out. The results show that it has high strain sensitivity and linear response within 0.6m scale distance, and can realize the continuous sensing of space and time disturbance signals along the optical fiber.

articleTitle: Bi-directional liquid level fiber optic sensor based on a cascaded hollow core fiber structure
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A high sensitivity bi-directional liquid level sensor based on a single mode fiber (SMF) - hollow core fiber (air core diameter of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$30 { {\mu m}})$</tex> - hollow core fiber (air core diameter of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$20 {\mu}\mathrm{m})$</tex> - SMF (SHHS) structure is reported. The proposed SHHS structure offers two types of radial Fabry-Perot (FP) resonance conditions in silica cladding hence two types of anti-resonant (AR) dips (Dip-20 and Dip-30) are excited in transmission spectra. It is demonstrated that both liquid level and liquid flowing direction can be monitored by simultaneously interrogating the intensity variations of two kinds of AR dips. The maximum liquid level sensitivities of Dip-20 and Dip-30 are estimated to be 0.014 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{dB}/{\mu m}$</tex> and 0.005 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{dB}/{\mu m}$</tex>, respectively.

articleTitle: Temperature-dependent tunable spectral filters and their applications in fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We designed and fabricated a temperature-dependent tunable filter based on cascaded long-period fiber gratings (LPFGs). Through the novel design, six LPFGs are concatenated together to realize the center wavelength, and the filter's bandwidth can be precisely adjustable only by controlling the temperature. Furthermore, an unprecedented performance is that the pulses do not experience the process of losing mode-locking to establishing mode-locking during the wavelength and bandwidth tuning procedure. It can realize two different tunings. First, 3-dB bandwidth remains unchanged while the spectrum's adjustment; second, it quantitatively changes through different heating modes. Such a flexible filter can also adopt in a Mamyshev oscillator to construct a curial part for self-starting and exploring relevant dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: A Hardware-Friendly Nonlinearity Equalizer via Random Forest Model
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a random forest model based nonlinearity equalizer for coherent optical communication system is proposed. The experimental results show that this is a hardware-friendly equalizer.

articleTitle: Probabilistically shaped CAP based on group-level labeling and graphene-shaped constellation
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper presents a probabilistically shaped (PS) carrier-less amplitude phase (CAP) modulation scheme enabled by group-level labeling and graphene-shaped constellation. A 9.8 Gb/s graphene-shaped PS 32-to-24 CAP transmission experiment over a 25-km standard single-mode fiber is successfully demonstrated. The results validates that our scheme can achieve a 1.8 dB receiver sensitivity improvement compared with the uniform CAP-32 signal due to the probabilistic and geometric shaping gain.

articleTitle: Microfiber acoustic sensor based on diaphragm structure
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A micro fiber acoustic sensor based on diaphragm structure is proposed. The thinnest waist region of microfiber was attached to the diaphragm surface by van der Waals' force to realize the packaging. Under the sound pressure level of 85 dB, the detection of 60–1000 Hz acoustic signal was realized. Finally, the vector sensing characteristic of acoustic signals was studied. The proposed microfiber acoustic sensor can respond to acoustic signals in the angle range of 324°-36° and 144°-216°.

articleTitle: Selenization Optimization for Efficiency CuInGa(S, Se)2 Solar Cells based on Sulfide Nanoparticles Ink
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The high-performance copper indium gallium sulfide selenide (CIGSSe) absorption layers based on nanoparticles ink is of great significance for large-scale production. In this paper, CuInGaS2 nanoparticles were synthesized and used for forming the absorption layer by selenization. After selenization optimization, 9.29% of power conversion efficiency is obtained on the CIGSSe device with absorber selenized under 0.1 SCCM (standard cubic centimeter per minute) N2 gas flow and 3 g selenium. Using X-ray diffractometry (XRD), and field emission scanning electron microscopy (SEM) characterization methods, we found that optimized selenization conditions resulted a large grained absorption layer.

articleTitle: Design of LED Intelligent Insect Monitoring Device Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: To improve efficiency of target insect trapping, we designed an intelligent insect monitoring system using STM32 micro controller and LED combination light source.

articleTitle: Weight-based re-grouped dynamic resource allocation algorithm in visible light communication and WiFi heterogeneous network
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A weight-based re-grouped resource allocation algorithm is proposed to improve the fairness of the system. Simulation results show that the algorithm improves the fairness index and throughput of the system, and has good practicality.

articleTitle: All-optical nonlinear activation function based on Germanium Silicon composite waveguide
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Nonlinear activation functions, a part of artificial neuron network, is responsible for nonlinearly mapping the input of the neuron to the output. The optical realization of nonlinear activation functions has become a research hotspot, which is optical activation function. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate an all-optical implementation of optical activation function based on germanium silicon composite waveguide, which takes advantage of the intrinsic absorption and the plasma dispersion effect of germanium in the communication band. It realizes two different nonlinear activation functions. This proves that our scheme has a great potential for optical activation functions.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Diagonal Extended Kalman Filter based on a Residual Decision for RSOP in Coherent Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive diagonal extended Kalman filter scheme based on a residual decision suitable for tracking and compensating the rotation of the state of polarization (RSOP) by adding a residual decision detector and diagonalizing the covariance matrix. It is shown through the simulation on the 28Gbaud PDM-QPSK coherent optical communication system platform that the proposed scheme has low complexity and great performance of the equalization for ultrafast RSOP.

articleTitle: Transmission stealth metasurface based on multilayer frame structures
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a metasurface stealth device with multilayer frame structure with beam differentiation, steering and collection, so that the incident electromagnetic beam is transmitted around the stealth object without scattering, and achieves stealth at 0.9THz.

articleTitle: Measurement of Longitudinal Resonance Frequency of Photoacoustic Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The first-order resonance frequency of the longitudinal photoacoustic cell was measured by resonance acoustic spectroscopy and photoacoustic spectroscopy, and the results were basically the same. Resonance spectrometry is more convenient and faster, but it is affected by some factors.

articleTitle: Chaos synchronization based on common signal optical injection
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel chaos synchronization scheme over 40 km fiber based on common signal optical injection. Meanwhile, the bandwidth of synchronized chaos is greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: Generation of Fiber-Tip Leaky Mode Resonance for Decoupling Bulk and Surface Properties
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Fiber-optic surface waves excited by nano-coatings deposited on the surface of optical fibers feature a strong enhanced evanescent field penetrating into external media, which enables the fiber-optic sensors highly sensitive to surrounding environment characterized by a bulk refractive index (RI). However, the enhanced evanescent field also suffers from changings in the surface of fiber-optic sensors, resulting in the bulk RI sensitivity being inevitably disturbed by the surface characteristics, which could lead to a crucial problem that plagues the sensing performance of fiber-optic systems. Herein, a fiber-tip leaky mode resonance (L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup>MR) probe is proposed, which is capable of decoupling bulk and surface characteristics around the probe without the need of any reference channels. This simple and compact probe consists of a standard multimode optical fiber with the end facet coated with a nanoscale thick titanium dioxide (TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) thin film, which can be used to effectively excite multiple fiber-tip leaky modes with a strong standing wave pattern in surrounding medium. We equated the changing in surrounding RI and the changing in thickness of surface-localized binding layer on the TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin film to the bulk and surface properties, respectively. The analysis shows that the generation of non-polarized fiber-tip L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup>MRs corresponds to the energy transfer or mode coupling from fiber core modes to the phased-matched fiber-tip leaky modes supported by the TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin film, and further modulation of leaky modes is in turn closely related to the thickness of the film. As the results further revealed, the resonance amplitude and wavelength of fiber-tip L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup>MRs vary linearly with the changes in bulk RI and thickness of surface-localized binding layer, which makes the fiber-tip L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup>MRs ideal for discriminating between bulk and surface characteristics around the probe. It is worth highlighting that both the highest bulk and surface sensitivities up to 58.5 dB/RIU and 0.595 nm/nm respectively, together with the smallest cross interference between them, can be attained with a single fiber-tip L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup>MR, which could greatly facilitate the development of ultra-compact lab-on-tip optrodes.

articleTitle: Artificial magnetic-based material for the detection of small magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The preparation of a kind of magnetic-based system, i.e., the incorporation of Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O4 nanocrystals into polydimethylsiloxane have been implemented in the experiment. Thereupon, the magnetic-based material could be developed into magnetic field sensors through assembling with various fibre-optic structures. It is proven that the artificial polymer demonstrates excellent performance in comparison with other magnetic materials like magnetic fluids, magnetostrictive materials, etc.

articleTitle: Ultra-low jittering of soliton molecular binding separation towards few hundreds of attoseconds
publicationTitle: 2022 20th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Mode-locked lasers with low noise have long been used as a practical test bed for complex dissipative nonlinear dynamics. Bound-state pulses from a mode-locked laser, also known as soliton molecules, attracted special attention due to their substantial intra-molecular dynamics. From the perspective of mathematics, stable self-organization pattern can be represented by a point attractor, surrounded by a finite basin of attraction which warrants stability and robustness against perturbations. One open question regarding wide-spread self-organization phenomena is the strength of the nonlinear attractor that determines stability of the self-organized pattern. In response to this question, we utilize optical cross-correlation technique to probe intra-soliton-molecular motion in real time with unprecedentedly attosecond resolution. We achieve ultra-low jittering of soliton molecular binding separation of 490 as in a stationary soliton molecule with 0.52 ps pulse separation.
